summary: On a member with [trim] local = true, only a person or the [trim] notify agent may resume a stopped trim; any other agent is refused. Correction to local-trim-own-cut: the local cut drops observer.observed only, not resource.observed

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change.

rules.detail: No retention rule change. Correction: LOCAL_TRIM_KINDS is observer.observed alone; resource.observed stays whole until its keep-set rule exists.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. The resume API and command are unchanged; an agent other than the [trim] notify agent now gets invalid-checkpoint-resume.

manual.detail: No manual step. A member with no [trim] notify agent is resumed by a person, as before local trim.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: any agent may resume such a member again.
